name: ConsumerProduct
description: A consumer-facing product record aligned with schema.org/Product and GS1 product master data.

gtin.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (8, 12, 13, or 14 digits).

sku.description: Internal stock keeping unit assigned by the brand or retailer.

name.example: Tide Pods Original Laundry Detergent, 42 Count

manufacturer.description: Legal manufacturer or marketer of the product.

category.description: Product category, typically aligned with GS1 GPC or the retailer's taxonomy.

gpcBrickCode.description: GS1 Global Product Classification brick code.

description.description: Marketing description for the digital shelf.

netContent.description: Net contents of the product unit.

countryOfOrigin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the product was made.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the textual attributes on this record.

targetMarket.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for markets where the product is sold.

lifecycleStatus.description: Current lifecycle stage of the product.

ingredients.description: Ingredient declaration as printed on the package.

price.description: Manufacturer suggested or current selling price.

digitalLinkUrl.description: GS1 Digital Link URI encoding the product's GTIN for omnichannel resolution.

modified.description: Last modification timestamp for this product record.
